integrity: Algebraic proof and independent exact specializations; no formal or independent review. General arguments distinguish infinite proof from finite examples.
scientific_limitations: Characteristic-zero, generic-coefficient biforms of bidegree (1,m), m>=2; the theorem classifies coordinate-eliminant leading and constant factors, not complete critical-locus degenerations or logarithmic A-discriminants. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: Coordinate-escape divisors for logarithmic critical points on Segre–Veronese toric surfaces
